instructions.output: OUTPUT Return the complete five-letter VALUE value for ASK, exactly as written. Do not return a key, shorten the value, explain, or add other text.
instructions.rules: RULES VALUE k v means key k has value v. REF k t means key k uses target t's final value. Last write to a key wins. Follow REF targets until VALUE. Example: VALUE AAAAA APPLE; REF BBBBB AAAAA; ASK BBBBB => APPLE.

scope: One fixed wording diagnostic. Source records, keys, values, query, order, model weights and chat template remain identical to the compact-language population. No extra prompt or seed search is authorized by this protocol.
